meta.method: Each document below was re-fetched from its own official host during this session with the research retrieval tool; the quoted sentence is copied from the retrieved text, not from the prior ledger. Status VERIFIED = the claim's supporting sentence was found in the retrieved text on 2026-11-11. Status NOT RE-CHECKED = the URL was not re-read in this pass; the row states what remains unconfirmed and is flagged rather than filled in.
meta.rate_note: Two different CNY/USD references appear. 7.129 is the IRS 2025 yearly average for U.S. tax translation (IRS official page, V18). 6.6911 is the Bank of China USD cash-remittance selling price at 10:25:02 on 2026-11-11 (V20). Neither is a customer-executable quote.

checks.claim: PRC FX regulations restrict current-account international payments and transfers only through genuineness/document review; the reviewed instruments impose no tax on the act of exchanging currency.
checks.doc: 中华人民共和国外汇管理条例 (Decree No. 532)
checks.quote: 第五条　国家对经常性国际支付和转移不予限制。 … 第十二条　经常项目外汇收支应当具有真实、合法的交易基础。
checks.quote_en: Art. 5: The State does not restrict current international payments and transfers. Art. 12: Current-account FX receipts and payments must have a genuine, lawful underlying transaction.
checks.limit: Proves a negative only for the reviewed instruments: no exchange tax is imposed here. It does not prove no personal tax is due on the underlying income.

checks.claim: An overseas individual converting lawful current-account RMB income must present ID plus transaction/source documents that include tax vouchers. This is the 'voucher gate', not a conversion tax.
checks.doc: 个人外汇管理办法实施细则 (Hui Fa [2007] No. 1)
checks.quote: （一）在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的相关证明材料（含税务凭证）办理购汇。
checks.quote_en: For lawful current-account RMB income obtained in China, FX purchase is handled against the person's valid ID and documents evidencing the transaction amount, including tax vouchers.
checks.limit: The rule is documentary. It does not state any rate, and it does not say a certificate equals a tax assessment.

checks.claim: SAFE's 2026 published FAQ repeats the same rule for an overseas individual's employment remuneration, citing Art. 59 of the 2020 current-account guidelines.
checks.doc: 2026年外汇管理互联网信息——个人外汇（08）
checks.quote: 境外个人在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的购汇资金来源材料（含税务凭证）在银行办理购汇。
checks.quote_en: An overseas individual's lawful current-account RMB income obtained in China is purchased into FX at the bank against valid ID and source-of-funds materials evidencing the amount, including tax vouchers.
checks.limit: Does not create a numeric salary ceiling and does not guarantee any particular bank's acceptance.

checks.claim: The USD 50,000 annual total applies to settlement and to a DOMESTIC individual's FX purchase (境内个人购汇). It is not stated as a universal ceiling for an overseas individual remitting lawful income.
checks.doc: 个人外汇管理办法实施细则 (Hui Fa [2007] No. 1)
checks.quote: 第二条　对个人结汇和境内个人购汇实行年度总额管理。年度总额分别为每人每年等值5万美元。
checks.quote_en: Art. 2: A annual total is applied to individuals' FX settlement and to domestic individuals' FX purchase; the annual total is the equivalent of USD 50,000 per person per year.
checks.limit: The wording distinguishes 境内个人 (domestic individual) from 境外个人. Applying USD 50,000 as a blanket limit on an overseas individual's salary remittance is not supported by this text; see Flag F01.

checks.claim: Reconversion of unspent exchanged RMB requires the original exchange memo and is valid for 24 months; up to USD 500/day (or USD 1,000 pre-departure at a port) needs ID only.
checks.doc: 2026年外汇管理互联网信息——个人外汇（10）
checks.quote: 原兑换水单的兑回有效期为自兑换日起24个月；对于当日累计兑换不超过等值500美元（含）以及离境前在境内关外场所当日累计不超过等值1000美元（含）的兑换，可凭本人有效身份证件办理。
checks.quote_en: The reconversion validity of the original exchange memo is 24 months from the exchange date; conversions of up to USD 500 equivalent in a day, or up to USD 1,000 at a port facility before departure, may be handled on valid ID alone.
checks.limit: Applies to reversing a prior exchange, not to converting salary.

checks.claim: An overseas individual's outward remittance of current-account FX from an FX savings account is handled on valid ID alone.
checks.doc: 个人外汇管理办法实施细则
checks.quote: 第十五条　境外个人经常项目外汇汇出境外，按以下规定在银行办理：（一）外汇储蓄账户内外汇汇出，凭本人有效身份证件办理；
checks.quote_en: Art. 15: Outward remittance of current-account FX by an overseas individual: (1) remittance from an FX savings account is handled against valid ID.
checks.limit: Covers remitting FX that is already in the account. It does not remove the documentary gate at the CNY-to-USD step.

checks.claim: Withdrawing foreign-currency cash above USD 10,000 equivalent in a day requires prior filing with SAFE through the bank.
checks.doc: 个人外汇管理办法实施细则
checks.quote: 第三十条　个人提取外币现钞当日累计等值1万美元以下（含）的，可以在银行直接办理；超过上述金额的，凭本人有效身份证件、提钞用途证明等材料向银行所在地外汇局事前报备。
checks.quote_en: Art. 30: Daily cash withdrawal of up to USD 10,000 equivalent may be handled directly; above that, prior filing with the local SAFE office is required.
checks.limit: Visa/mobile banking limits and branch practice are separate.

checks.claim: A third party may handle the FX purchase and outward remittance of an overseas individual's RMB salary (a proxy is expressly contemplated).
checks.doc: 个人外汇业务解答（三）
checks.quote: 境外个人在境内的人民币工资收入，可以自行购汇汇出，汇出手续也可委托公司财务人员等其他个人代为办理。
checks.quote_en: An overseas individual's onshore RMB salary income may be purchased and remitted by the individual, or the remittance formalities may be entrusted to another person such as company finance staff.
checks.limit: A bank may still demand a notarised/legalised power of attorney; that is bank policy, not quoted here.

checks.claim: There is no statutory time limit on converting and remitting lawful historic RMB salary, provided the original evidence of the income can be produced.
checks.doc: 个人外汇业务解答（五）
checks.quote: 法规并未限定境外个人境内取得的合法人民币收入购汇汇出时间，但境外个人须能够提供当时取得人民币合法收入的证明材料，由银行按照展业三原则进行真实性审核。
checks.quote_en: The rules do not limit the time for purchasing and remitting an overseas individual's lawful onshore RMB income, but the individual must be able to produce the evidence of that income, and the bank reviews genuineness under the know-your-customer principle.
checks.limit: Bank-level document retention practice is the practical constraint; not addressed by this Q&A.

checks.claim: PRC FX violations carry fines of up to 30% of the amount, or 30% to 100% in serious cases; privately trading or brokering FX is punished the same way.
checks.doc: 外汇管理条例 (Decree No. 532)
checks.quote: 第三十九条 …处逃汇金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处逃汇金额30%以上等值以下的罚款 … 第四十五条 私自买卖外汇、变相买卖外汇、倒买倒卖外汇或者非法介绍买卖外汇数额较大的 … 处违法金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处违法金额30%以上等值以下的罚款。
checks.quote_en: Art. 39 evasion: fine up to 30% of the amount, or 30%–100% in serious cases. Art. 45 unauthorised FX trading/broking: same structure.
checks.limit: Fine base and 'serious circumstances' are decided case by case; not a predicted liability.

checks.claim: HSBC China outward telegraphic transfer: individual Private Banking free; Premier and Advance 0.1% of the amount, minimum CNY 100, maximum CNY 500, plus cable charge of CNY 120 per cable (Premier/Advance).
checks.doc: Tariff of Accounts and Services for Wealth and Personal Banking Business (effective 31 Oct 2026)
checks.quote: Telegraphic Transfer Issuance 2.2.4.1 … For individual customer: Free [Private Banking] … 0.1% of remittance amount Min. CNY100 / equivalent per transaction Max. CNY500 / equivalent per transaction Plus Cable Charge [Premier, Advance]; Cable Charges 2.2.4.2 … CNY120 / equivalent per cable [Premier, Advance]
checks.quote_en: As quoted.
checks.limit: Bank policy only, for one bank and one segment. Excludes the FX margin and all other institutions' charges (tariff Note 7).

checks.claim: HSBC Global Transfer to a self-named overseas HSBC account is published Free for Private Banking and Premier and USD 20 actual (CNY 145 indicative) for Advance. The tariff's USD 7 figure belongs to International Education Payment, not to a same-name remittance.
checks.doc: Tariff (effective 31 Oct 2026)
checks.quote: Fund transfer to self-name HSBC accounts in other countries/ territories via HSBC Global Transfer | 2.2.6.1 | Free | Free | CNY145 * per transaction This is an indication charge. The actual charge per transaction will be USD20 … | HSBC International Education Payment | 2.2.7 | Free | Free | CNY50 * per transaction … The actual charge per transaction will be USD7
checks.quote_en: As quoted.
checks.limit: Requires self-named HSBC accounts in both countries and Premier/relationship eligibility (tariff Important Note 3).

checks.claim: Withdrawing foreign-currency notes over the HSBC China counter is free for all three segments, but USD/HKD of USD 5,000 or more needs at least three working days' notice.
checks.doc: Tariff (effective 31 Oct 2026)
checks.quote: Foreign Currency Notes Withdrawal Over Counter … 2.2.2.1 | Free | Free | Free … For each cash withdrawal, if meet any of below criteria, it is subject to at least three working days' advance notice … 1) USD/HKD: amount equal to or above USD5,000 equivalent.
checks.quote_en: As quoted.
checks.limit: Physical cash still has to be carried across the border and declared (V17).

checks.claim: Wise from-CNY: maximum CNY 300,000 per transfer from a China bank app, CNY 50,000 from Alipay; a tax record within the last three years is required; the recipient must be an account you own.
checks.doc: Guide to CNY transfers
checks.locator: Sections 'Who can send money from CNY', 'How much can I send'
checks.quote: You have a valid tax record issued by the China tax authority showing taxes paid within the last 3 years … Due to regulations, you can only send CNY from China to another account you own … If you're sending CNY from your China bank app, the maximum you can send in one transfer is 300,000 CNY … Alipay … 50,000 CNY.
checks.quote_en: As quoted.
checks.limit: Provider policy, not a regulator; the percentage fee is only shown in-app and is left blank in the cost tables.

checks.claim: For an individual's personal transaction, foreign-currency gain on disposing of nonfunctional currency is not recognised unless the gain would exceed USD 200.
checks.doc: 26 U.S.C. § 988, 2024 edition
checks.quote: no gain shall be recognized for purposes of this subtitle by reason of changes in exchange rates after such currency was acquired by such individual and before such disposition. The preceding sentence shall not apply if the gain which would otherwise be recognized on the transaction exceeds $200.
checks.quote_en: As quoted.
checks.limit: The USD basis and acquisition dates are private facts; a de minimis exclusion is not a conclusion about any particular balance.

checks.claim: The 2026 maximum foreign earned income exclusion is USD 132,900.
checks.doc: 2026 Instructions for Form 2555
checks.quote: Exclusion amount. For 2026, the maximum exclusion amount has increased to $132,900.
checks.quote_en: As quoted.
checks.limit: Requires the tax-home test plus bona fide residence or physical presence; election interacts with the foreign tax credit.

checks.claim: Currency or monetary instruments above USD 10,000 brought into or sent out of the United States must be reported to CBP on FinCEN Form 105; failure risks forfeiture and civil or criminal penalties.
checks.doc: Money and Other Monetary Instruments
checks.locator: Federal mandate to report; 'What if I don't file?'
checks.quote: Federal law mandates that when entering or leaving the United States you must report amounts exceeding $10,000 to U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) … An Individual who fails to file a report or submit false or fraudulent information, risk having their currency or monetary instruments forfeited and seized.
checks.quote_en: As quoted.
checks.limit: Applies to physical carriage, not to a wire.

checks.claim: The IRS publishes the 2025 yearly average for China (Yuan) as 7.129 CNY per USD, and states it has no official exchange rate.
checks.doc: Yearly average currency exchange rates
checks.quote: The Internal Revenue Service has no official exchange rate. Generally, it accepts any posted exchange rate that is used consistently. … China | Yuan | 7.129 | 7.189 | 7.075 | 6.730 | 6.452
checks.quote_en: As quoted.
checks.limit: A tax-translation rate, not a transaction rate.

checks.claim: Overseas ATM withdrawals with mainland bank cards are capped at RMB 100,000 per person per calendar year and RMB 10,000 per card per day; exceeding the annual cap suspends overseas cash withdrawal for the current and following year.
checks.doc: Circular on Regulating Large-sum Overseas Cash Withdrawals with Bank Cards (Hui Fa [2017] No. 29)
checks.quote: the sum of withdrawals using the bank cards under the name of the individual (including supplementary cards) shall not exceed the equivalent of RMB 100,000 in every civil year … will not be allowed to withdraw cash overseas with the domestic bank cards in the current and second years … the ceiling for every foreign currency card per day is to be adjusted … to the equivalent of RMB 10,000
checks.quote_en: As quoted.
checks.limit: Effective 1 Jan 2018. Issuer/ATM-operator fees are separate and not published here.

checks.quote_en: As quoted.

checks.authority: PRC tax authority / IRS treaty documents
checks.doc: Individual Income Tax Law; 1984 U.S.–China income tax treaty
checks.locator: IIT rate schedule; treaty dividend article
checks.limit: Retrieved document not re-read line by line in this pass. The 3%–45% schedule and the 10% treaty dividend rate used in the cost table are prior-session values and are flagged for a targeted re-read; no new tax conclusion is added here.
